name: plannotator
description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.
one_liner: A review inbox for AI coding agents — it collects the plans, code diffs, and documents your AI assistants produce so a human (or a team) can mark them up and send feedback back with one click, instead of copy-pasting across chat windows.
buyer: A tech lead or engineering manager whose team runs several AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, etc.) in parallel and needs one place to review what they're producing.
business_use_cases: An engineering team uses it as the shared review surface for every AI-generated PR before a human merges it, replacing scattered Slack threads.
A dev agency running client work through multiple AI coding tools uses it to give clients one clean place to approve plans and specs.
A solo founder uses it to keep track of and approve what their fleet of coding agents is doing overnight.

money_ideas.idea: Charge teams a per-seat subscription for the hosted/shared-with-team version
Sell a one-time onboarding package helping dev agencies set up a standard agent-review workflow for their clients

steal_this: Package a 'team' tier with shared review links and audit history, and sell it to agencies running multiple AI coding agents for clients — the free version already works solo, so the paid upsell is purely collaboration.
